questionText:
Match the missing data function in List I with its action in List II:

List I:
(A) df.isna().sum()
(B) df.fillna(0)
(C) df.dropna(axis=1)
(D) df.fillna(method='ffill')

List II:
(I) Counts total missing values in each column
(II) Replaces all NaN values with 0 across the DataFrame
(III) Drops all columns containing any NaN value
(IV) Forward-fills missing entries using previous valid values
